about_the_game:
Demo:
17 sets unlocked, some sets incomplete
Over 100 items across 6 major categories
1 major stage with 10 sub-stages, 2 mini-dungeons, 2 bosses, 20+ enemies
20+ relics
3 playable characters
15 meta-progression talents
Easy and Normal modes available, Normal mode offers 3 difficulty modifiers
30+ skills

Full Version:
43 sets with inter-set synergies
400+ items, 70+ unique gems with distinct mechanics, deeper build customization
5 major stages, 3 mini-dungeons, 10 bosses, 100+ enemies
70+ relics
6 playable characters, each with exclusive playstyles
60+ meta-progression talents
Hard and Nightmare modes added, plus 7 additional difficulty modifiers
130+ skills

In the shattered continent of Aethria, an abyssal corrosion from deep underground is quietly spreading. This dark energy from ancient times distorts everything and transforms living beings into bloodthirsty monsters. The only thing that can resist the corrosion is the magic gems scattered around the world - they are ancient relics, containing pure and uncontaminated magic.
These gems can not only give the power to control elements and strengthen the body, but also create the ultimate weapon against the abyss through synthesis.



Classic turn-based combat allows for careful planning. No penalties for failure—retry and refine your gem combos until you perfect your build.



Defeat enemies to collect coins and elemental gems (fire, frost, lightning, etc.). Mix and match hundreds of gems to create explosive, sustained, or unique playstyles.


Face 40+ enemies with unique mechanics (gem devouring, evolution, damage reflection, etc.). Counter them with 400+ gems, preset decks, and relics to unleash devastating combos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10/11
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 10/11
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for Vulkan
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Aetheria falls to darkness. Collect 400+ magic gems (fire/ice/lightning) to craft weapons in turn-based battles. Outsmart unique enemies with strategic combos. Purge the abyss!
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
